title: Let water users own it, and investors take the loss
answer: In this simulation, Parliament would put Thames Water into a trust owned by its water users. Shareholders lose their stake. Lenders take losses instead of passing old debts to bills or taxes. Users and workers elect the board, with local meetings able to demand repairs. Keep staff and water supplies running. Pay managers extra only when independently checked service targets are met. Publish repair spending, spills and board votes. Pursue proven wrongdoing through the courts. Judge success by reliable taps, protected jobs and fewer spills after accounting for rainfall: dry weather helped explain the 2025 fall (s5). Give users the power to vote directors out.
